review_summary: The junior differential captures the major categories for resistant hypertension and correctly prioritizes non‑adherence. Adjustments were made to lower the weight of fibromuscular dysplasia and add a note about pain‑related sympathetic activation. Missing renal and electrolyte labs are the most urgent gaps; obtaining them will clarify secondary‑hypertension possibilities.
